subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap + next steps from our pricing discussion so your finance team has something to react to.

Call highlights
- Primary use: conversational assistant + re-ranking for customer support.
- Estimated steady-state usage: 50M - 120M tokens/month (spikey during launches).
- Target monthly budget: still under evaluation, rough signal from you was $80k-$150k/month for inference.

High-level unit economics and benchmarking (ballpark, post-batching & caching optimizations)
- OpenAI (GPT family, hosted): ~ $5,000 per 1M tokens (higher for GPT-4 variants) — representative of managed premium API.
- Anthropic: ~ $3,500 per 1M tokens.
- Other open-model hosts (managed infra for open LLMs): ~ $2,000 per 1M tokens (varies by instance type & quantization).
- Redwood target for Acme (depending on quantization + dedicated vs shared capacity): $1,200 - $1,800 per 1M tokens — we get there via aggressive batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantized model variants for many request types.

Notes on estimates
- These are delivered costs (inference only) — do not include data transfer, logging retention, or advanced support/SLAs.
- Actual unit price scales with committed volume and reserved capacity; Dedicated reservations can materially reduce unit price vs hosted bursts.
- We expect additional savings on high cache-hit workloads (templated prompts, long-running sessions).

Next steps
1) I attached a short pricing sheet (Acme_Redwood_Pricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx) with tiered $/1M token ranges by reservation level — please share with Sarah/finance.
2) Can you confirm a tighter expected monthly token range (50M / 75M / 100M / 120M) so I can run committed vs on-demand scenarios?
3) If acceptable, I’ll loop in our solutions engineer (Marissa) to propose a 90-day mutual action plan and a projected TCO comparison vs your current host(s).

If it helps, I can also prepare a per-route breakdown (chat vs embeddings vs reranking) that shows where batching/caching buys the most.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 50M-120M estimate is our conservative gating range. Assuming success in Q4 launch, we could see sustained 100M+ months.
- Our target monthly budget in your ballpark would be closer to $100k-$140k for inference only; we'd be looking at a blended target $/1M token ceiling of roughly $1,200-$1,400 to make the ROI work for the use cases we've modeled.

Can you confirm the following so I can take this back to finance:
1) If we commit to 100M tokens/month for 12 months, what is Redwood's target $/1M delivered? (preferably in a small table: reservation level -> $/1M).
2) Are there different pricing bands for chat vs embeddings vs reranking? (we have a lot of short chat sessions plus a smaller number of embedding calls).
3) Given you referenced OpenAI/Anthropic, do you have a short TCO example (1 pager) comparing Redwood-on-open-models vs those hosts on a 100M token/month footprint?

Cc'd Sarah (CFO) so she can chime in on any procurement questions.

Alex

Alex/Sarah — thanks for the clarity. Quick answers below and attached a one-page TCO summary:

1) Committed examples (delivered per-1M-token pricing, inference-only, USD)
- On-demand (no commit): $2,200 / 1M tokens
- 12-month commit, 100M/month: $1,350 / 1M tokens
- 12-month commit, 200M/month: $1,150 / 1M tokens
- Dedicated reserved pool (annual contract + SLA): $900 - $1,100 / 1M tokens (depending on instance mix & quantization)

2) Routing & banding by route
- Chat (short-turn, high-turnover): standard band above; effective price lowered with batching and session-level KV cache.
- Embeddings: ~0.6x of chat cost on average (smaller models / lower memory footprint).
- Reranking: varies; for full-context reranks cost can be higher per-call but benefits from shorter model variants and caching for repeated candidates.

3) Attached: short TCO comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic for 100M tokens/month (includes host API costs, expected batching savings, and estimated data egress).

Next actions
- I attached the TCO_1pager.pdf and the updated pricing sheet.
- If helpful, Marissa can run a route-level projection next week and join a 30-minute pricing review with Sarah & finance.
- If the 100M x 12 scenario looks viable, I can prepare a draft term sheet and the preferred invoice cadence.

Thanks — I’ll hold on next steps until I hear from Sarah on procurement timing.

Best,
